name: ci-workflows
//: The GitHub Actions workflows and their contract tests (.github/tests): the fixed status-check contexts each reported on every pull request, the per-event tier routing (.github/scripts/gate-tier.mjs) and its hand-off through the gate step to the real gate recipe, and the notignored review workflow standing apart from the contract. It depends on terminal-approval because that root project owns the files these tests read outside this directory — the justfile (the gate recipe) and release-plz.toml (the release branch prefix) — and Nx selects affected projects by file ownership, so the edge is what reruns this suite when they change.
